question.text: An accredited investor with Rs. 15 crore wants differentiated returns across cycles. Best channel:

answer.text: Mix of PMS, AIFs (Cat I/II/III) and direct equity

explanation.text: The Logic: HNIs benefit from diversification across PMS, AIFs and direct holdings. The Trap: Single-instrument exposures under-diversify. Cross-Exam Context: Same in X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Allocate specific sleeves (e.g., 50% PMS / 30% AIF / 20% direct) per HNI preference.
